programme_facts.value: The Education and Health Sciences (EHS) Faculty includes the Schools of Medicine, Allied Health, Education, and Nursing and Midwifery as well as the Departments of Psychology, Physical Education and Sport Sciences. programme_facts.value: The Irish World Academy of Music and Dance is the centre of academic and performance excellence at University of Limerick, Ireland. It honours the energies of performance and academic reflection across a wide range of genres and disciplines. These are informed by community outreach and artist-in-residence initiatives that take the Academy to the wider community, attracting international performance and scholarly expertise.
